Card Q&A.a: You can place them from your Digimon in the battle area, your Digimon's link cards, or cards in your trash.Additionally, you can choose a total of 6 cards from any or all of these areas. For example, 1 from your Digimon in the battle area, 2 from link cards, and 3 from your trash.
Card Q&A.q: From what areas can I place the specified cards to meet the conditions of this card's [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.  The conditions for this [Main] effect require you to place 6 of the specified cards as digivolution cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I only place 5 specified cards as digivolution cards to meet the conditions of this card's [Main] effect?
When placing multiple cards into the place specified by this card's effect, can I choose what order to place them in?
After processing "by doing x" in this card's [Main] effect, can I choose not to digivolve?

Effect: ＜Use Req. ([Seven Code] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)

[Main] By placing 6 [Seven Code] trait Digimon cards from your battle area, link cards or trash as 1 of your [Seven Code] trait Digimon's bottom digivolution cards, that Digimon may digivolve into [Dantemon] in the hand, ignoring digivolution requirements and without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower [Appmon] trait card from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
